questions: What is the exact modeled role and transition logic of Step7 in the parallel branch sequence?
What are the exact definitions of the Initial-to-Step1 conditions startEnable and B3 available?

Should the corrected CR-017 return valve-group membership be treated as exactly the observed sets {V20,V24,V25,V1,V3} for B6->B1 and {V18,V22,V23,V5,V6} for B7->B2, or only the branch destinations are approved?
B7 cooling completion temperature: Merge resolved this to 25 degC current/approved. Confirm, or choose a different value.
Post-evaporation return routing destinations: Merge resolved this to B6 condensate returns to B1 via P2; B7 concentrate returns to B2 via P1. Confirm, or choose a different value.

StandardWater versus WaterNaCl applicability: Merge resolved this to StandardWater is baseline integration-test medium only; WaterNaCl is the intended physical medium. Confirm, or choose a different value.

Whether B5 and K1 may be combined in simulation: Merge resolved this to A combined evaporator/condenser simulation component is allowed only as an abstraction; K1 remains a separate physical component in system architecture. Confirm, or choose a different value.
